personal.jobTitle: Engineering Leader | Software Architect | Full Stack Developer

summary: Engineering leader with 8+ years of experience building and scaling backend platforms for fintech, trading, and high throughput digital ecosystems. Led cross functional teams of up to 15 engineers across backend, DevOps, and QA, achieving 99.95% platform uptime on AWS. Architected failover gateways for low latency trading, event driven microservices (RabbitMQ, CQRS, SAGA), and robust BCP frameworks. Proven track record in cloud modernization, security compliance (ISO 27001, OWASP), and accelerating delivery by 30% through AI assisted engineering practices.

bullets: Designed and built an end to end AI automated engineering workflow covering the full delivery lifecycle: feature planning, architecture, design, task breakdown, implementation, QA automation, code review, deployment, and security scanning, using Claude Code, Cursor, and Kiro, OpenRouter And Antigravity

Implemented retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over project specs, architecture decisions, and the codebase, giving AI agents consistent context so generated code follows existing conventions and the component system.

Automated QA and release gates (test generation, automated code review, dependency and security scanning) in the CI/CD pipeline, shipping features ~60% faster while keeping human review on architecture and security decisions.

Independently owned architecture and product implementation for production web applications built with React, Next.js, TanStack (Query, Router), and TypeScript, backed by Go, Python, Laravel  and Node.js services.
Led the design of reusable UI patterns and scalable component structures to keep features consistent, maintainable, and fast to ship.
Improved frontend responsiveness, SEO, accessibility, and user experience, achieving Lighthouse scores of 95+ across Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO.
Hardened the application with a strict Content Security Policy, HSTS, and a full set of security headers, earning an A+ rating on securityheaders.com.
Integrated backend APIs for authentication, analytics, payments, and product workflows, ensuring frontend behavior stayed reliable across releases.
roles.techStack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Go, Laravel, AWS, Cloudflare, PostgreSQL, Python, Posthog, Sentry

bullets: Architected a failover gateway for high-frequency trading operations, guaranteeing business continuity with sub-30-second recovery and 99.95% uptime during market hours.
Led production cloud migration to AWS, raising platform uptime to 99.95% and cutting incident detection time by 60% through ELK-based observability.
Built and led a 12-engineer cross-functional engineering team, cutting release cycle time from 2 weeks to 3 days while instituting automated testing and code quality standards.
Introduced AI-assisted development practices using Kiro and OpenRouter, improving sprint delivery speed by 30% and automating code reviews, unit test generation, and boilerplate scaffolding.
Established enterprise BCP frameworks and automated operational reporting across 15 mission-critical systems, saving ~80 hours per month in manual reporting.
roles.techStack: AWS, Cloudflare, MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, ELK, Go, Node.js, Laravel, Docker, FIX API

bullets: Spearheaded core architecture modernization, decomposing a legacy monolith into 8 event-driven microservices behind an API gateway as the single entry point, so all external traffic is routed, authenticated, and rate-limited centrally instead of reaching services directly, and reducing deployment duration from hours to under 15 minutes.

Authored structured, versioned API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger) for every service, giving frontend, QA, and partner teams a single source of truth and cutting integration and onboarding time by ~60%.
Pioneered automated DevOps and CI/CD pipelines, increasing release frequency from monthly to weekly and reducing production deployment errors by 70%.
Delivered proof of concept integrations with liquidity providers via REST and FIX API, and built a trading simulation environment to backtest 12 algorithmic strategies.

Implemented real-time notification streaming with WebSockets (Socket.IO), broadcasting trade executions and price feeds to ~3,000 concurrent users with sub-second latency.
